statement.summary: Theorem 4.4 is certified by two Props: the original frozen `ShiftSym.enumerationStatement` (Statement.lean; |S| = `enumerationRHS`, the sum re-indexed by the divisors h ≠ 1 of rad(n)^d) and the Phase-H bridge `P04.rankVectorReindexStatement` (the paper's rank-vector right side `mainFormulaRHS` equals `enumerationRHS`). Phase H did NOT re-freeze eq. (2) as a single Prop; its verbatim form is the composite (helper P04.numSS_eq_mainFormulaRHS). The sentence 'All exponents are integers' is `P04.exponentsIntegerStatement`, and the ℕ-division used in the exponents is justified by `P04.exponentEncodingStatement`.
deltas: Alphabet Σ = `Fin σ`; |S_{n^d}| = `Nat.card` of the subtype of shift-symmetric configurations, cast to ℤ.

The certified main Prop is divisor-indexed: Σ_{v ∈ {0..d}^k, v ≠ 0} ↔ Σ_{h ∈ divisors(rad(n)^d), h ≠ 1} via h = ∏ p_i^{v_i}; (−1)^{1+|v|} ∏ r_d(p_i,v_i) ↔ `coeffOf d h` (|v| = Ω(h), v_i = v_{p_i}(h), product over the prime factors of h); n^d ∏ p_i^{−v_i} ↔ `n ^ d / h`. The bridge to the paper's indexing is the separately proved `rankVectorReindexStatement`.
Exponents are ℕ-quotients n^d / ∏ p_i^{v_i}; exactness is proved (`exponentEncodingStatement`, `dvd_pow_of_mem_divisors_rad`).
p_1 < ⋯ < p_k = `primeSeq n` (0-based i : Fin k, k = n.primeFactors.card); rank vectors are functions Fin k → ℕ.
r_d(p,v) = `rdCoeff p v d` with the q-Pascal `gaussBinom` (fidelity to the product formula: P01.gaussBinomProductFidelityStatement).
Integrality sentence: computed in ℚ with zpow; quantified over all v ∈ {0..d}^k including v = 0 (harmless strengthening).

maps.label: eq. (2): |S_{n^d}| = Σ_v (−1)^{1+|v|} ∏ r_d(p_i,v_i) σ^{n^d ∏ p_i^{−v_i}}

lean.text:
(Nat.card {s : Config n dd (Fin σ) // IsShiftSymmetric s} : ℤ)
      = enumerationRHS n dd σ
mainFormulaRHS n d σ = enumerationRHS n d σ

maps.note: The certified theorem (`enumerationStatement`, frozen before Phase H) states the count = the DIVISOR-indexed `enumerationRHS`. The paper's rank-vector form is `mainFormulaRHS`; `rankVectorReindexStatement` (Phase H bridge) says the two right sides are equal. Eq. (2) verbatim is the composite of the two Props (in Lean: P04.numSS_eq_mainFormulaRHS, a helper, not a frozen Prop). The equation is in ℤ (the count is cast from ℕ because the right side has signs).

maps.label: n ≥ 2
maps.note: Verbatim antecedent.

maps.label: d ≥ 1
maps.note: Verbatim antecedent (the dimension is named `dd` in Statement.lean).

maps.label: σ ≥ 1
maps.note: Verbatim antecedent; σ = 1 is included as the paper allows for counting statements.

maps.label: alphabet Σ with |Σ| = σ ↦ Fin σ

tex.text:
a finite alphabet $\Sigma$ with
$\sigma=|\Sigma|\ge2$ (for counting statements, $\sigma=1$ is also allowed)

maps.note: Only |Σ| enters; the alphabet is fixed to Fin σ.

maps.label: |S_{n^d}|

lean.text: Nat.card {s : Config n dd (Fin σ) // IsShiftSymmetric s}
∃ v : Lat n d, v ≠ 0 ∧ shift v s = s

maps.note: S_{n^d} = configurations fixed by some nonzero translation (`IsShiftSymmetric`); |·| = `Nat.card` of the subtype (the same expression as `numSS`). 𝒜 = `Lat n d = Fin d → ZMod n`.

maps.label: right side in the paper's rank-vector indexing

lean.text:
∑ v ∈ rankVectors n d,
    (-1 : ℤ) ^ (1 + ∑ i, v i) * (∏ i, (rdCoeff (primeSeq n i) (v i) d : ℤ)) *
      (σ : ℤ) ^ (n ^ d / ∏ i, primeSeq n i ^ v i)

maps.note: `mainFormulaRHS` (Paper/S04) transcribes the paper's sum term by term.

maps.label: n = ∏ p_i^{α_i}, p_1 < ⋯ < p_k, k = ω(n)

tex.text: the number of distinct prime factors of $n$ is $k=\omega(n)$

maps.note: k = `n.primeFactors.card`; p_i = the i-th smallest prime factor (0-based index i : Fin k).

maps.label: v = (v_1,…,v_k) ∈ {0,…,d}^k
maps.note: Rank vectors are functions Fin k → ℕ with values in range (d+1).

maps.label: v ≠ 0
maps.note: v ≠ 0 as a function.

maps.label: (−1)^{1+|v|}
maps.note: Sign in ℤ.

maps.label: |v| = Σ_i v_i
maps.note: Sum over i : Fin k.

maps.label: ∏_{i=1}^k r_d(p_i, v_i)

lean.text: (∏ i, (rdCoeff (primeSeq n i) (v i) d : ℤ))

maps.note: Note the argument order `rdCoeff p v d` for r_d(p,v); cast ℕ → ℤ.

maps.label: r_d(p,v) = p^{C(v,2)} [d v]_p

lean.text: | dd + 1, r + 1 => gaussBinom q dd r + q ^ (r + 1) * gaussBinom q dd (r + 1)

maps.note: Gaussian binomial by the q-Pascal recurrence; its agreement with the paper's product formula (§3) is the separately proved fidelity Prop of group 01.

maps.label: σ^{n^d ∏_i p_i^{−v_i}}

lean.text: (σ : ℤ) ^ (n ^ d / ∏ i, primeSeq n i ^ v i)

maps.note: The exponent is the ℕ-quotient n^d / ∏ p_i^{v_i}.

maps.label: n^d ∏_i p_i^{−v_i} as ℕ-division (exact)

lean.text: n ^ d / ∏ i, primeSeq n i ^ v i

(((n ^ d / ∏ i, primeSeq n i ^ v i : ℕ)) : ℚ)
      = (n : ℚ) ^ d * ∏ i, ((primeSeq n i : ℚ) ^ (-(v i : ℤ)))

maps.note: `exponentEncodingStatement` (not a paper sentence) proves that the ℕ-quotient equals the rational number n^d ∏ p_i^{−v_i} for every v ∈ {0..d}^k, so no truncation occurs.

maps.label: divisor reindexing: Σ_v ↔ Σ_{h | rad(n)^d, h ≠ 1}

lean.text:
∑ h ∈ ((rad n) ^ dd).divisors.erase 1,
    coeffOf dd h * (σ : ℤ) ^ (n ^ dd / h)
∀ n d σ : ℕ, mainFormulaRHS n d σ = enumerationRHS n d σ

maps.note: Bijection v ↦ h = ∏ p_i^{v_i}: v ∈ {0..d}^k ⟺ h | rad(n)^d, and v = 0 ⟺ h = 1. The bridge is stated for all n, d, σ (both sides are 0 in the degenerate cases) and proved (P04.sum_rankVectors_eq).

maps.label: {v ∈ {0..d}^k, v ≠ 0} ↔ divisors of rad(n)^d except 1
maps.note: h | rad(n)^d iff every exponent v_p(h) ≤ d and h has only prime factors of n; erasing 1 removes v = 0.

maps.label: (−1)^{1+|v|} ∏ r_d(p_i,v_i) ↔ coeffOf d h

lean.text:
(-1 : ℤ) ^ (1 + bigOmega h) *
    ∏ p ∈ h.primeFactors, (rdCoeff p (h.factorization p) dd : ℤ)

maps.note: v_i is recovered as h.factorization p_i; the product runs over the prime factors of h only (primes with v_i = 0 contribute r_d(p,0) = 1, so nothing is lost: P04.coeffOf_phi).

maps.label: |v| ↔ Ω(h)
maps.note: |v| = Σ v_i = Ω(h), the number of prime factors of h with multiplicity.

maps.label: n^d ∏ p_i^{−v_i} ↔ n^d / h
maps.note: ℕ-division by h = ∏ p_i^{v_i}; exact because every such h divides n^d (`dvd_pow_of_mem_divisors_rad`).

maps.label: All exponents are integers

lean.text: ∃ m : ℕ, (n : ℚ) ^ d * ∏ i, ((primeSeq n i : ℚ) ^ (-(v i : ℤ))) = (m : ℚ)

maps.note: Exponent computed literally in ℚ with integer powers p_i^{−v_i}; 'integer' is ∃ m : ℕ (it is positive).

maps.label: for every v ∈ {0..d}^k (also v = 0)
maps.note: Harmless strengthening by the trivially integral case v = 0 (exponent n^d).

maps.label: n ≥ 2, d ≥ 1 for the integrality sentence
maps.note: σ does not occur in the exponents and is not quantified.
